_meta_itemized.notes: Cindy Marchant Keyes, County Auditor, 2022 Post-Election. The county's blank form typed into, 3 pages (p1 cover, p2 contributions, p3 expenses), ~40 and ~35 empty ruled rows following the data. No embedded text layer (draft.py returned nothing); both ledger pages read full-page at 200 dpi. SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: this Post-Election copy is NOT redacted - the Mailing Address and Zipcode columns are fully legible - while the SAME filer's Pre-Election copy (20636) of the SAME ledger is county-redacted in those columns. The county's redaction pass was applied per-document, not per-candidate. Nothing was back-filled: 20636's rows keep their honestly blank city/state, and this filing's rows carry the city/state its own page prints. The Mailing Address column here holds CITY + STATE only ('Peoa UT', 'Park City UT') with no street, so donor_city/donor_state are read straight from it; the specimen row's PO box is dropped with the specimen. The county's blank form prints its own title typo, '2022 Campaign Finacial Report', on p2. GEOMETRY IS MEASURED: rowbands detects 40 uniform bands on p2 and 35 on p3, and on this filing the detected vertical rules span the WHOLE table (7.32-89.57% on p2, 10.15-89.08% on p3), so no declared frame is needed. Band 1 is the column header and band 2 the specimen on both pages; real rows are bands 3-6 (p2) and 3-5 (p3). Verified end to end at 500 dpi: p2 band 3 -> '2/24/22 Stewart Grow / Peoa UT / 84061 / $100.00', p2 band 6 -> '10/24/22 Cindy M Keyes / Peoa UT / 84061 / $991.79', p3 band 5 -> '10/9/22 Square Space / Campaign Website / $270.24'.
